Todos with macrotasks, timers and statistics, in the good old carnival look. Each project is a plain `TODO.md` you can read and edit by hand, kept in sync with your own server.

## Download

- **macOS 13 or newer** (Apple Silicon and Intel): [TasksBar.zip](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/releases/download/v2.0.1/TasksBar.zip)
- **Windows** (64-bit): [TasksTray.exe](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/releases/download/v2.0.1/TasksTray.exe)

The apps aren't signed yet, so your system will warn you the first time:

- **macOS:** unzip, move `TasksBar.app` to Applications, then run this once:
  ```sh
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/TasksBar.app
  ```
- **Windows:** choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## What's included

- **Menu bar and tray apps:** see the current task and its timer, pause, resume or finish it, switch to any other todo, and check today's total. They ask how far along you are while you work, and pause the timer when the computer sleeps.
- **Command line and sync daemon:** link a project folder once, like a git repository, and its `TODO.md` stays in sync. Edits on both sides are merged.
- **Web app:** the full view of your projects, with the timeline and statistics, on desktop and phone.
- **Server:** runs in Docker and stores everything as Markdown files, with no database.

## Before you start

The apps connect to a Tasks server you run yourself, and they get its address from the command line tool:

1. Set up the server by following [DEPLOY.md](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/blob/v2.0.1/DEPLOY.md). It has no login of its own, so it must run behind a reverse proxy with a login service.
2. Install the command line tool from a copy of this repository, with Node.js 20 or newer:
   ```sh
   npm ci && npm run cli:install
   ```
3. Connect this computer. It logs you in by showing a QR code and a code to approve from a browser on any device:
   ```sh
   tasks remote set https://tasks.example.com
   ```

The tray apps and the daemon then share that login. If it ever ends, choose **Log in…** in the app's menu or run `tasks login`.

## New since 2.0.0

- The apps can now be downloaded from this page, without a GitHub account.
- The macOS app now runs on Intel Macs as well as Apple Silicon.
